date_note: OVHcloud's status notices give 24 November as the start day; the pages give no earlier day.
title: OVHcloud Public Cloud outage in the Paris EU-WEST-PAR region hits Compute Instances and Managed Kubernetes
geo_basis: region named on the status page: EU-WEST-PAR (Paris)
summary: OVHcloud's status page says a Compute Instance incident in zone EU-WEST-PAR-A left customers unable to reach their instances; the resolved notice says all instances were unavailable. A separate notice says some Managed Kubernetes worker nodes in EU-WEST-PAR were unavailable and new clusters could not be ordered. OVHcloud attributes both to an unexpected underlying infrastructure malfunction and marked both resolved on 24 November.
plain: OVHcloud says customers in its Paris cloud region lost access to virtual servers and some Kubernetes nodes on 24 November, caused by an infrastructure malfunction. Both notices are marked resolved.
exec: OVHcloud's own notices report Paris-region servers and Kubernetes nodes unavailable; it cites an infrastructure malfunction.
